params.name: header
params.description: Request HTTP header, e.g. "GET /page.html HTTP\1.0"+Char(13)+Char(10)+... (CRLF-separated fields).

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the raw HTTP request header as a single string.

params.name: valueArray
params.description: HTTP header field values, synchronized index-for-index with fieldArray.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the HTTP request header split into parallel field-name/field-value arrays.
